articles.headline: India to charge bulk Scotch imports 162.5% duty
articles.brief: India is set to impose a 162.5% duty and tax on bulk Scotch imports amid a standoff over the UK trade pact. The higher rate exceeds pre-pact levels, raising concerns over shipment delays and capital pressures.

articles.headline: Developed-market fiscal deficit to hit post-war high
articles.brief: J.P. Morgan warns that developed-market fiscal deficits are heading toward their highest levels outside of a recession since World War 2, driven by persistent spending and economic shifts.

articles.headline: LPG tanker hit by projectiles off Bulgaria
articles.brief: An official confirmed that an LPG tanker that sank off the coast of Bulgaria was struck by projectiles, raising maritime security alarms in the region.

articles.headline: Binance plans Asia expansion following massive crypto heist
articles.brief: Following a massive $6.3 billion crypto heist, cryptocurrency exchange Binance is pushing forward with ambitious plans to expand its operations across Asian markets.

articles.headline: Pan-Indian study highlights DNA fragments in cancer detection
articles.brief: A new pan-Indian study reveals that higher levels of circulating DNA fragments in blood can strengthen cancer detection signals, advancing early diagnostic methodologies.

articles.headline: Mauricio Pochettino takes over Manchester United
articles.brief: Mauricio Pochettino has officially arrived at Manchester United to undertake a rescue mission as the storied football club fights to climb out of the Premier League relegation zone.

articles.headline: Cyclone Akvan intensifies into severe storm
articles.brief: Cyclone Akvan has rapidly intensified over the Bay of Bengal, putting multiple coastal districts on red alert as it heads toward a predicted landfall along the Indian coastline.
